rules.rule: Flag violations of contract compatibility and evidence binding; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of lease fencing, monotonic clocks and unknown accounting; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of isolation, physical send admission and secret containment; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of independent verification, bounded retries and effect reconciliation; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of frozen corpus integrity and offline parity; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of reviewed proposals and compare-and-swap; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of three-zone routing and non-delegable authority; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of tenant isolation, webhook authentication and token scrubbing; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Flag violations of exit codes and honest closure evidence; cite concrete scenarios and preserve package boundaries.
Keep inputs and outputs synchronized with the implementation; protect secrets and host qualification.
Check current source behavior, evidence boundaries, page shape, links and module-map ownership.
Keep the entry points and package boundaries accurate and link to owning documentation.
